purpose: Request a narrow owner decision on whether to open a controlled, authorized, loopback-only causal lab for selected WebGoat and crAPI cases. This packet is not a run authorization, P10 qualification, or Bug Bounty authorization.

decision_requested.primary: Approve or reject a bounded local causal lab for the explicitly listed cases and controls.
not_requested: Bug Bounty or external target access

targets.ground_truth_status: not_admitted_for_scoring; proposed lab GT must be separate and immutable after approval

targets.version: local compose source with VERSION=latest; immutable image digest not admitted
targets.ground_truth_status: not_admitted_for_scoring; VERSION=latest requires an immutable image digest before reproducibility admission

immutable_provenance.immutable_runtime_requirement: Before any lab run, pin every WebGoat/crAPI runtime artifact by source revision plus container/image digest or equivalent immutable build digest. A Git source revision alone does not make crAPI VERSION=latest reproducible.

proposed_lab_boundary.authorization_scope: Authorized local lab only; no public or external targets.

network_policy.auxiliary_canary: Only an explicitly approved loopback-only fixture service, if required by a selected oracle; otherwise absent.

data_policy.identities: Synthetic local identities only; no real email addresses, passwords, tokens, OTP, MFA, or third-party accounts.
data_policy.secrets: No real secrets. Synthetic credentials may be generated only after explicit owner approval for a case that requires local authentication.
data_policy.evidence: Persist hashes, typed metadata, verifier decisions, and redacted proof references only; never raw bodies, cookies, authorization headers, tokens, or passwords.

allowed_actions_after_approval: Start pinned local services bound to 127.0.0.1 only.
Create synthetic test identities inside an isolated disposable database or fixture.
Perform the exact case-specific methods listed in this packet.
Use non-destructive canary records and restore from a clean snapshot between cases and runs.
Seal, verify, replay, and compare redacted ProofBundles.
forbidden_actions: Any external target, Bug Bounty program, OAST, callback, public DNS, or internet service.
Any credentials or personal information supplied by the user or from a real account.
Any destructive reset outside the disposable lab snapshot.
Any method, route, payload, identity, or case not explicitly approved in the owner decision.
Any change to frozen Ground Truth, P10 thresholds, Generic Core, or qualification state.

identity_and_state_model.identity_model: Two or more synthetic identities generated inside the disposable local lab, named only by opaque test IDs (for example test_subject_a and test_subject_b). They must not correspond to real users.
identity_and_state_model.authorization_model: Each case declares the minimum role and ownership relation. Cross-user cases require an owner identity and a distinct requester identity; controls must exercise the requester against its own object or an intentionally public object.
identity_and_state_model.state_model: Immutable source/runtime snapshot plus disposable database/fixture snapshot. Seed only synthetic canary records. Capture a pre-run state hash, restore before every candidate/control pair, and capture a post-run state hash.
identity_and_state_model.reset_model: Stop on reset failure. Restore the disposable snapshot or destroy/recreate the lab. Do not use application reset endpoints unless separately approved as a safe, non-destructive local action.

owasp_webgoat.identity_model: Synthetic user A owns a profile; synthetic user B is the requester; no real credentials.
owasp_webgoat.state_model: Seeded profile canaries in disposable state; restore between candidate and control.
owasp_webgoat.causal_oracle_proposal: The requester B receives an owner-specific canary only when requesting A's profile, and the authorization outcome differs from B's own-profile control; status code alone is insufficient.
owasp_webgoat.independent_negative_control: Request B's own profile and a non-existent opaque profile ID; no owner canary may appear in either control.
owasp_webgoat.central_verifier_mapping: WebGoat adapter profile -> IDOR semantic verifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
owasp_webgoat.proof_bundle_procedure: Redacted typed observation only; ProofBundle must bind source/runtime hashes, identity relation, candidate/control decisions, state hashes, seal, verify_seal, and replay.
risks: Any unexpected disclosure beyond the canary stops the run.
owasp_webgoat.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

owasp_webgoat.identity_model: Synthetic local session only if required by the lesson; no real credentials.
owasp_webgoat.state_model: Disposable fixture contains a non-sensitive canary file and a sibling control file; restore before each pair.
owasp_webgoat.causal_oracle_proposal: A bounded path-resolution request exposes only the approved canary file under the vulnerable condition while the sibling/authorized control does not; file presence or HTTP 200 alone is insufficient.
owasp_webgoat.independent_negative_control: Authorized file control, invalid opaque path, and a sibling path that must remain inaccessible.
owasp_webgoat.central_verifier_mapping: WebGoat path-traversal profile -> file-content canary verifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
owasp_webgoat.proof_bundle_procedure: Redacted canary classification, no raw file contents, bound to state/source/runtime hashes and seal/replay identifiers.
risks: Path traversal payloads require strict bounded allowlisting.
No real files or host filesystem paths may be accessed.
owasp_webgoat.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

owasp_webgoat.identity_model: Synthetic local lesson identity only; no real credentials.
owasp_webgoat.state_model: Disposable comment store with one non-network, non-exfiltrating canary marker; restore after the pair.
owasp_webgoat.causal_oracle_proposal: A stored marker reaches the approved DOM sink/execution observation in the candidate flow while a benign encoded marker remains inert in the independent control; lesson completion is insufficient.
owasp_webgoat.independent_negative_control: Benign encoded marker and clean page control under the same identity/state reset.
owasp_webgoat.central_verifier_mapping: WebGoat stored-XSS profile -> DOM sink/dialog semantic verifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
owasp_webgoat.proof_bundle_procedure: Persist only typed sink/execution classification and hashes; never persist raw comment body, cookies, or headers; seal/verify/replay required.
risks: No network calls, exfiltration, or destructive payloads are allowed.
owasp_webgoat.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

owasp_webgoat.identity_model: Synthetic local lesson identity if required; no real credentials.
owasp_webgoat.state_model: Disposable database snapshot containing non-sensitive canary rows; restore for candidate/control.
owasp_webgoat.causal_oracle_proposal: A narrowly allowlisted differential query behavior demonstrates unauthorized row selection without destructive SQL or status-only inference; the independent parameterized control must not show the effect.
owasp_webgoat.independent_negative_control: Parameterized benign input, invalid opaque input, and known-safe query baseline.
owasp_webgoat.central_verifier_mapping: WebGoat SQL-injection profile -> differential query-result classifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
owasp_webgoat.proof_bundle_procedure: Only typed result-shape/count classification and hashes; no raw database rows or credentials; seal/verify/replay required.
risks: Reject any statement containing destructive or multi-statement behavior.
Stop if the endpoint or database leaves the approved snapshot.
owasp_webgoat.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

owasp_webgoat.causal_oracle_proposal: Not proposed: causal proof would require external/callback behavior, prohibited by the current boundary.
owasp_webgoat.independent_negative_control: Not applicable until an explicitly approved loopback-only oracle is designed and reviewed.
owasp_webgoat.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

owasp_webgoat.causal_oracle_proposal: Not proposed: cross-site state-changing behavior is outside the current approved boundary.
risks: State-changing cross-site testing is not in the current scope.
owasp_webgoat.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

crapi.identity_model: Synthetic user A owns a video; synthetic user B is the requester; synthetic local auth only after approval.
crapi.state_model: Disposable database with opaque canary object ownership; restore between pairs.
crapi.causal_oracle_proposal: B obtains A's unique canary object metadata only under the unauthorized object request, while B's own-object and nonexistent-object controls do not disclose it; HTTP status alone is insufficient.
crapi.independent_negative_control: B own-object control and nonexistent opaque object control.
crapi.central_verifier_mapping: crAPI identity/profile adapter -> object-ownership semantic verifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
crapi.proof_bundle_procedure: Redacted object-field classification only; no token, cookie, or raw body persistence; seal/verify/replay required.
risks: Requires synthetic authentication and cross-user ownership state.
crapi.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

crapi.identity_model: Synthetic users A/B and a synthetic vehicle owned only by A; local auth after approval.
crapi.state_model: Disposable vehicle/owner fixture with location canary; restore between pairs.
crapi.causal_oracle_proposal: B receives A's location canary for the unauthorized vehicle request while own-vehicle and nonexistent-vehicle controls do not; status code alone is insufficient.
crapi.independent_negative_control: B own vehicle and nonexistent vehicle controls.
crapi.central_verifier_mapping: crAPI vehicle adapter -> ownership/location semantic verifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
crapi.proof_bundle_procedure: Persist only redacted canary classification and hashes; seal/verify/replay required.
risks: Sensitive location canary must be synthetic and non-real.
crapi.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

crapi.identity_model: Synthetic users A/B and a synthetic post owned by A; local auth after approval.
crapi.state_model: Disposable post fixture with opaque canary; restore between pairs.
crapi.causal_oracle_proposal: B receives A's private canary post field under unauthorized access while own and nonexistent post controls do not.
crapi.independent_negative_control: B own post and nonexistent post controls.
crapi.central_verifier_mapping: crAPI community adapter -> post-ownership semantic verifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
crapi.proof_bundle_procedure: Typed redacted disclosure decision, state/source/runtime hashes, seal/verify/replay; no raw post body.
risks: Requires authenticated synthetic identities and privacy canary.
crapi.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

crapi.identity_model: Synthetic users A/B and a synthetic report/service request owned by A; local auth after approval.
crapi.state_model: Disposable workshop fixture; restore between pairs.
crapi.causal_oracle_proposal: B receives A's report canary under unauthorized access while own and nonexistent report controls do not.
crapi.independent_negative_control: B own report and nonexistent report controls.
crapi.central_verifier_mapping: crAPI workshop adapter -> report-ownership semantic verifier -> central causal and negative-control verifier.
crapi.proof_bundle_procedure: Redacted canary classification and hashes only; seal/verify/replay required.
risks: Requires authenticated synthetic identities and ownership fixture.
crapi.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

crapi.identity_model: Synthetic local identity only after separate approval.
crapi.causal_oracle_proposal: Not admitted yet: requires stateful business mutation and a reviewed invariant oracle.
risks: Mutation and business-state side effects require a separate decision.
crapi.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

crapi.identity_model: Synthetic local accounts only after explicit approval; no real credentials or tokens.
crapi.causal_oracle_proposal: Not admitted yet: authentication/token semantics need a dedicated reviewed oracle and credential handling protocol.
crapi.independent_negative_control: Invalid synthetic credential control only after approval.

crapi.promotion_rule: No scoring promotion unless every gate is evidenced; lab admission is not Official P10 approval.

crapi.state_model: No application reset endpoint; use snapshot restore.

execution_protocol_after_approval.quality_gate: No metrics are computed or promoted until an independent lab GT, complete causal oracle, safe precondition, independent negative control, central verifier, regression, and sealed/replayable evidence all pass.
execution_protocol_after_approval.promotion_gate: Lab evidence cannot open Official P10. Official P10 requires separate governance approval, an approved set meeting 10 cases/6 classes, three valid isolated runs, recomputed metrics, and final review.

stop_conditions: Any socket bind or request resolves outside 127.0.0.1.
Any external connection, redirect follow, DNS/public-IP resolution, OAST, or callback occurs.
Any unapproved method, route, identity, payload, or state change is attempted.
Any raw body, header, cookie, password, token, or credential appears in persistent evidence.
Any reset/restore state hash mismatch occurs.
Any negative control is missing, non-independent, or produces the same causal signal unexpectedly.
Any verifier cannot distinguish candidate from control or ProofBundle seal/verify/replay fails.

cleanup: Stop local services and auxiliary fixtures.
Delete synthetic identities and canary data from the disposable lab.
Retain only redacted evidence, hashes, decisions, and audit metadata.
rollback: Restore the disposable database snapshot or recreate the lab from pinned artifacts.
Revert only target-local adapter/profile commits if an approved implementation is later made.
Never reset, force-push, or alter frozen Ground Truth, Generic Core, thresholds, or governance state.

generic_vs_target_local_boundary.generic_core: No change requested. ActionAuthority, CampaignExecutor, central verifier, ProofBundle, sealing/replay, and governance gates remain unchanged.
generic_vs_target_local_boundary.target_local: WebGoat and crAPI routes, semantic predicates, fixture setup, identity/ownership mappings, and adapters must remain target-local.
generic_vs_target_local_boundary.generic_change_rule: A generic change may be proposed only if the same deficiency is demonstrated on more than one Target and regression proves no weakening of scope or governance.

decision_options.name: Keep closed
decision_options.scope: No local credentials or mutation; retain source inventory only.
decision_options.risk: No new causal quality evidence; P10 gap remains.

decision_options.name: Approve staged read-only causal lab
decision_options.scope: Approve only WebGoat IDOR/path traversal and crAPI object-access cases listed as candidate_for_narrow_owner_approval, using synthetic identities, disposable fixtures, GET-only methods, and no external callbacks.
decision_options.risk: Requires synthetic authentication state and careful ownership canaries.
decision_options.rollback: Destroy/recreate disposable lab and restore snapshot.

decision_options.name: Approve full listed local lab
decision_options.scope: Also approve WebGoat stored XSS/advanced SQLi and any separately selected crAPI mutation/auth cases under the exact per-case controls.
decision_options.risk: Higher mutation, credential, and payload risk; requires per-case confirmation.
decision_options.rollback: Snapshot restore and target-local commit revert.

recommendation: Choose Option B as a staged first gate. Do not approve mutation, authentication/token, destructive reset, SSRF, or external/callback cases in this decision. After B produces complete causal evidence, issue a separate packet for any additional cases.
